integrity: The classification is obtained by an exhaustive recursive/nonrecursive split. The nonrecursive dichotomy was checked in Cintioli's Corollary 7; the countable upper bound and exact three-degree recursive exception were checked in Richter--Stephan--Zhang's conclusion. The two trivial recursive degrees were verified directly.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies only the cardinality of the finite-one degrees inside a many-one degree. It does not classify their internal order structure, prove new interpolation theorems, or settle existence of least finite-one degrees.
title: The finite-one cardinality spectrum inside many-one degrees is one, three, or countably infinite
